phases.title: JavaScript/TypeScript bounded LOGIC
phases.objective: Establish a bounded duplicate-condition LOGIC rule with conservative binding and mutation proof.
exit_criteria: 24-case M19 corpus accepted with zero false positives and zero false negatives on Ubuntu, Windows, and macOS.
Exact-main post-merge acceptance completed.

phases.title: JavaScript/TypeScript parser-grade foundation
phases.objective: Introduce a deterministic pure-Go parser authority for JavaScript, JSX, TypeScript, and TSX while preserving accepted M18/M19 rule behavior and fail-closed syntax handling.
exit_criteria: Pure-Go parser dependency is pinned and release cross-compilation remains valid without CGO.
JS/JSX/TS/TSX syntax validation is fail-closed for parser errors, ERROR nodes, and MISSING nodes.
Existing M18/M19 corpora remain regression-clean.
JSX/TSX parser-backed corpus passes on Ubuntu, Windows, and macOS.
Release/install and governance lanes pass on one exact candidate and exact main.

phases.title: Language analyzer framework
phases.objective: Stabilize reusable analyzer capability, parser/provider, rule metadata, evidence, deterministic-ID, and benchmark contracts for later languages.
exit_criteria: New analyzers can declare recognition, parser authority, rule capabilities, evidence boundaries, and availability without copy-paste core changes.
Framework contract is regression-tested across existing Go, Python, and JavaScript/TypeScript analyzers.

phases.title: Rust semantic baseline
phases.objective: Add conservative Rust semantic evidence for core categories using language-appropriate parsing and scope rules.
exit_criteria: Rust SECURITY, SIMPLIFY, LOGIC, and conservative DEADCODE evidence have labeled and adversarial corpora.
BLOAT is enabled only if safe evidence is proven.
Cross-platform CI and repository-shaped validation pass.

phases.title: Java and Kotlin semantic baseline
phases.objective: Add JVM-family semantic analysis with package, class, method, and build-system awareness.
exit_criteria: Java and Kotlin bounded rules pass synthetic, adversarial, and repository-shaped tests.
Maven/Gradle project boundaries are handled conservatively.
Ubuntu, Windows, and macOS acceptance passes.

phases.title: C and C++ semantic baseline
phases.objective: Add conservative C/C++ analysis aware of headers, declarations, definitions, macros, and conditional compilation.
exit_criteria: Header/include and declaration-definition evidence is deterministic.
Macro and conditional-compilation ambiguity fails closed.
No aggressive dead-code claim is accepted without target-aware proof.

phases.title: C#/.NET semantic baseline
phases.objective: Add project/solution-aware C# semantic evidence for namespace, type, member, async, nullable, logic, and credential patterns.
exit_criteria: Project/solution scope and generated-code boundaries are represented.
Core bounded rules pass adversarial and multi-OS validation.

phases.title: Dart/Flutter semantic baseline
phases.objective: Add Dart/Flutter analysis for imports, classes, functions, widgets, async constructs, and generated-file boundaries.
exit_criteria: Flutter-shaped repositories are covered by bounded real-world evidence.
Generated code is not misclassified as hand-maintained authority.

phases.title: Scripting ecosystem
phases.objective: Add bounded PHP, Ruby, PowerShell, and Shell analyzers while preserving Python authority.
exit_criteria: Each scripting language has its own parser/evidence contract rather than a generic regex-only claim.
Language-specific corpora and multi-OS regression lanes pass.

phases.title: Swift, Zig, and MQL5 specialist support
phases.objective: Add conservative specialist-language support after the shared analyzer framework is stable.
exit_criteria: Swift, Zig, and MQL5 each have explicit bounded support levels and labeled corpora.
Unsupported semantics remain fail-closed and clearly reported.

phases.title: Repository-scale intelligence
phases.objective: Add cross-file symbol/import/dependency graphs, generated/test/reference awareness, monorepo support, incremental analysis, and deterministic caching.
exit_criteria: Cross-file evidence is deterministic and bounded.
Monorepo and large-repository scans have validated memory/runtime behavior.
Incremental results match clean scans for unchanged source.

phases.title: Developer integrations
phases.objective: Stabilize public integration surfaces for CI, editors, MCP/Skill clients, and machine-readable consumers.
exit_criteria: Stable JSON/SARIF and exit-code contracts are versioned.
GitHub/GitLab annotation, pre-commit, and editor integration boundaries are validated.
MCP/Skill protocol compatibility is regression-tested.

phases.title: Production hardening
phases.objective: Harden DoctorCode for large, malformed, adversarial, and untrusted repositories across supported operating systems.
exit_criteria: Performance, memory, cancellation, fuzzing, symlink/path/archive safety, dependency supply-chain, update, uninstall, and backwards-compatibility gates pass.
No supported scan path executes analyzed repository code.

phases.title: v1.0 GA qualification
phases.objective: Qualify DoctorCode for broad public use with multi-language real-world evidence, clean-install testing, documentation, support workflows, and release-candidate acceptance.
exit_criteria: Release candidate passes Windows, Linux, and macOS on one exact SHA and exact merged release SHA.
Production-grade support is demonstrated for Go, Python, and JavaScript/TypeScript.
Supported semantic baselines and specialist support levels are explicitly documented.
v1.0.0 release provenance, integrity, installation, update, uninstall, and user documentation are complete.
